name: Generar index.json

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - '**'   # ejecuta en todas las ramas

jobs:
  build-index:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write   # permite commit/push

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Generar index.json (Python, seguro con espacios)
        run: |
          python3 - << 'PY'
          import os, json

          base_dir = 'fichas'
          nombres = set()

          for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(base_dir):
            for fname in filenames:
              lower = fname.lower()
              if lower.endswith('.txt') or lower.endswith('.jpg'):
                nombre_sin_ext = os.path.splitext(fname)[0]
                nombres.add(nombre_sin_ext)

          index = sorted(nombres)

          with open('index.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(index, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
          PY

      - name: Commit y push index.json
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add index.json
          git commit -m "Actualizar index.json automáticamente" || echo "Sin cambios"
          git push
